title: reserve
description: wal.sh/tools/display v0.2.1, Wire protocol: the reserve message.

display.description: optional; the relay's default display when omitted

ttl.description: seconds; optional (300 in this kit); the lease is at most 900 s, and a relay clamps a larger ttl to 900 (granted.expires shows the ttl it applied)

format.description: the format the source sends; pal16 when omitted; rgb24 is accepted at the relay only
